purpose: Make BLACK single-instance and Windows-login persistent: retire obsolete user-level BLACK unit, create direct Windows Startup WSL launcher, preserve canonical system service, and repair amx user-session linger when permitted noninteractively.
command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '===RETIRE_LEGACY_USER_BLACK==='
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/systemd/user"
if [ -L "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/amx-black.service" ] || [ -e "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/amx-black.service" ]; then
  rm -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/default.target.wants/amx-black.service"
  echo USER_BLACK_WANTS_REMOVED
else
  echo USER_BLACK_WANTS_ABSENT
fi
if [ -f "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/amx-black.service" ]; then
  mv "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/amx-black.service" "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/amx-black.service.retired-20261002"
  echo USER_BLACK_UNIT_RETIRED
else
  echo USER_BLACK_UNIT_ABSENT
fi

echo '===WINDOWS_STARTUP_LAUNCHER==='
P='/mnt/c/Users/eztra/AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup'
mkdir -p "$P"
LAUNCHER="$P/AMX-BLACK-WSL.cmd"
printf '@echo off\r\nstart "" /min %%SystemRoot%%\\System32\\wsl.exe --exec /bin/true\r\nexit /b 0\r\n' > "$LAUNCHER"
echo "LAUNCHER=$LAUNCHER"
cat "$LAUNCHER"

echo '===USER_SESSION_REPAIR==='
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  echo SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE=yes
  sudo -n loginctl enable-linger amx || true
  sudo -n systemctl start user@1000.service || true
else
  echo SUDO_NONINTERACTIVE=no
  timeout 8s loginctl enable-linger amx </dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
sleep 2
loginctl show-user amx -p State -p Linger -p RuntimePath -p Sessions 2>&1 || true
systemctl status user@1000.service --no-pager -n 20 2>&1 || true

echo '===CANONICAL_BLACK_SYSTEM_SERVICE==='
systemctl is-enabled amx-black.service
systemctl is-active amx-black.service
systemctl show amx-black.service -p User -p MainPID -p SubState -p ActiveState --no-pager
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,args | grep '/home/amx/amx-black/BLACK/worker.py' | grep -v grep || true

echo '===FINAL==='
[ -f "$LAUNCHER" ] && echo WINDOWS_STARTUP_LAUNCHER_PRESENT=yes
[ "$(systemctl is-active amx-black.service)" = active ] && echo BLACK_SYSTEM_SERVICE_ACTIVE=yes
